beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So many people crowded the shore to hear Jesus that he pushed a small boat out onto the water and taught them from there, the whole hillside listening.

timing.text: So many people crowded the shore to hear Jesus that he pushed a small boat out onto the water and taught them from there, the whole hillside listening.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And he told them a story about a farmer, and four kinds of ground.

timing.text: And he told them a story about a farmer, and four kinds of ground.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying,

timing.text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying,

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

timing.text: Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A farmer went out to scatter his seed. He did not measure it out grain by grain. He flung it wide, across every kind of ground, hoping all of it would grow.

timing.text: A farmer went out to scatter his seed.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

timing.text: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some fell on the hard path, packed down by every foot that had ever walked it. It never sank in, and the birds came and ate it.

timing.text: Some fell on the hard path, packed down by every foot that had ever walked it.
It never sank in, and the birds came and ate it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That, he said, is a heart so hardened that the word never gets below the surface before it is snatched away.

timing.text: That, he said, is a heart so hardened that the word never gets below the surface before it is snatched away.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some fell on thin soil over rock. It sprang up fast, green and hopeful, but it had no root, and when the sun grew hot it withered.

timing.text: Some fell on thin soil over rock.
It sprang up fast, green and hopeful, but it had no root, and when the sun grew hot it withered.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is the heart that says yes with joy, but has nothing underneath to hold it when things get hard.

timing.text: That is the heart that says yes with joy, but has nothing underneath to hold it when things get hard.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some fell among thorns. The seed grew, but so did the weeds, and the worries and wants of this life crowded in and choked it before it could bear anything.

timing.text: Some fell among thorns.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

timing.text: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But some fell on good ground, open and soft and ready. It took root, and grew, and gave back a harvest many times over.

timing.text: But some fell on good ground, open and soft and ready.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

timing.text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The good ground is simply the heart that hears him, takes it in, and holds on. And it gives back far more than was ever put in.

timing.text: The good ground is simply the heart that hears him, takes it in, and holds on.
And it gives back far more than was ever put in.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Notice the farmer did not skip the hard path or the rocky places. He threw seed everywhere, on every heart, hoping. That is how generous God is with his word.

timing.text: Notice the farmer did not skip the hard path or the rocky places.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

timing.text: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And ground can change. A hard path can be broken up. Rocky soil can be cleared. That is how good he is. He keeps sowing, and he never stops hoping your heart will be the good ground.

card.text: None of these soils are fixed forever. What is the soil of your heart today?
